LocaleResource.Name: Plugins.Description.MotorShop.SupplierCatalog
LocaleResource.Value: Imports a supplier catalog package (products.json + images) with categories, brands, sizes and pictures.

LocaleResource.Name: AdminInstruction
LocaleResource.Value: Upload a catalog package (.zip with products.json and an images folder). Categories and brands are created when missing, products are matched by SKU, so importing the same package again updates instead of duplicating. Pictures are only added to products that have none.

LocaleResource.Name: Package.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Contains products.json and images/*.jpg. Max. 512 MB.

LocaleResource.Name: UpdateExistingProducts
LocaleResource.Value: Update name, description and price of existing products

LocaleResource.Name: ImportFailed
LocaleResource.Value: The catalog import failed. See the log for details.
